systemd = systemd or SubprocessSystemd(unit_dir=layout.unit_dir)
    journal_source = journal_source or completion.SystemdJournalSource(user=True)
    identity = identity or ProcessIdentity()
    queue_drain = queue_drain or (lambda: controller.runner_queue_drain(effects))
evidence.reason: `production_adapter` applies defaults with `or`, so an injected port/fake that is falsy (for example a `SystemdPort` fake whose `__len__` reports zero pending jobs) is silently discarded and replaced with the real `SubprocessSystemd` or other production default. That defeats the injection seam and can make later adapter calls reach the real user manager. The parameters default to `None`, so the smallest compatible fix is to test `is None` for each injected dependency.
